component.name: Mini Task Manager
component.summary: Task manager applet for the COSMIC™ desktop

description.p: A task manager applet for the COSMIC™ desktop environment. It lives in your panel and follows the desktop's light and dark theme.
Inspect running applications and the top CPU and memory consumers, spot stopped, zombie, or unresponsive processes, and stop, resume, or kill them from the popup.
The application ID no longer uses the COSMIC name, at System76's request. Settings and panel placement are reset by this change; re-add the applet and set your preferences again.
Project renamed to cosmic-ext-mini-taskmanager to follow System76's COSMIC trademark policy, which reserves the "cosmic-" namespace for official COSMIC software.
Killing a process now also kills its children, so nothing is left orphaned.

ul.li: Threads are no longer listed as separate processes, which inflated the process count and double-counted CPU usage.
Per-process CPU is now a share of the whole machine, matching the figure in the header.
Fixed a crash on command lines containing non-ASCII characters.
An explicit Dark or Light choice is no longer overridden by the desktop's own light/dark switch.

description.p: Initial release of Cosmic Mini Task Manager applet.
